title: Intermediate topological pressures and variational principles for nonautonomous dynamical systems
summary: We introduce a one-parameter family of intermediate topological pressures for nonautonomous dynamical systems which interpolate between the Pesin-Pitskel topological pressure and the lower and upper capacity pressures. The construction is based on the Carathéodory-Pesin structure in which all admissible strings in a covering satisfy $ N \le n < N/θ+ 1 $, where $ θ\in [0,1] $ is a parameter. The extremal cases $θ=0$ and $θ=1$ recover the Pesin-Pitskel pressure and the two capacity pressures, respectively.
